subject.title: resolveCliAuthEpoch invalidates every live CLI session when local credential source-of-storage flips, even though identity is unchanged

question: What identity signal should define Claude CLI reusable-session auth epochs when OpenClaw has an auth profile but the local Claude credential file may appear or disappear without a real account change?
rationale: The source-proven bug is narrow, but the safe fix requires a human auth-boundary choice because Claude CLI credentials may not expose a stable account id in the local file path used by this resolver.

options.title: Approve A Scoped Identity Fix
options.body: Define a Claude CLI-specific rule that keeps epochs stable for same-profile storage-presence flips and fails closed when logout or account identity cannot be proven safe.

options.title: Narrow And Adopt A Related PR
options.body: Choose one open related PR as the canonical implementation path after it removes broad public API changes and proves real identity-change invalidation.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed Behavior
options.body: Document the current resets as the intended auth safety tradeoff and close the related fix attempts as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve A Scoped Identity Fix
recommendation.body: Define a Claude CLI-specific rule that keeps epochs stable for same-profile storage-presence flips and fails closed when logout or account identity cannot be proven safe.
